name: extract
description: Full-page extraction: opens a page in the owner's main Chrome, scrolls until no new content loads (progress reported), reads it through the DOM (screenshot + vision as backup for visual pages), extracts the requested fields as structured JSON, and files the result durably - a spreadsheet, a note or ISHTI's memory (asks where if unclear).
route: extract / scrape / collect a list of items (names, prices, titles...) from a web page into a spreadsheet, note or memory
